# Paul Pacey Photography

> Paul Pacey is a marketing photographer and visual strategist for private international schools and school groups. Over 15 years he has photographed more than 200 marketing campaigns for schools in over 30 countries. He is based in Prague, Czech Republic, and works worldwide.

Paul's work combines deliberate pre-production planning with documentary-style photography on the day: real moments of school life rather than posed ones, people first with the campus as the backdrop, and lighting that doesn't look lit. The images are made for school websites, prospectuses, social media and admissions campaigns. This is marketing photography, not picture-day portraits.

He works with marketing, admissions and communications teams at individual international schools, marketing leaders at school groups, and in-house content creators. His portfolio is private and shared only with school staff, through a personal access link.

## Services

- [Strategic Shoot](https://paulpacey.photography/services.html#core): the core offer. An audit of the school's website, brand pillars and imagery; a tailored shot list; drafted teacher and parent communications; one to three days on location; a final edit within 72 hours (around 300 images for a two-day shoot).
- [Marketing Visual Audit](https://paulpacey.photography/services.html#audit): a standalone review of how a school's brand language and images work together, with prioritized recommendations.
- [Multi-Year Visual Partnership](https://paulpacey.photography/services.html#partnership): planned campaign photography for schools and school groups, with future shoot dates and pricing reserved in advance.
- [Remote Critique & Training](https://paulpacey.photography/services.html#training): small-group online sessions for in-house photographers and content creators.
- [Services FAQ](https://paulpacey.photography/services.html#faq): planning time, shoot length, privacy and consent, delivery, travel, pricing.

- [Planning Your Photo Campaign](https://paulpacey.photography/planning-guide.html): a nine-step framework for planning a school marketing photo campaign.
